title: CmdPal: Fluent, theme-aware host config for Adaptive Cards

proposed_comments.body:
### Describe the alpha-preserving formatter accurately

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking documentation correction: `ToHex` formats the supplied alpha byte, so it also represents translucent and fully transparent colors; it does not force opacity. Please describe that existing behavior rather than promising an opaque result. This changes documentation only, not the formatter or rendered colors.

```suggestion
    /// <summary>Formats a color with alpha as <c>#AARRGGBB</c>.</summary>
```
proposed_comments.title: Describe the alpha-preserving formatter accurately

confidence.rationale: Exact current source supports this explicitly non-blocking clarification; existing guards and caller behavior are preserved.

proposed_comments.body:
### Qualify the bounded-cache identity guarantee

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking contract clarification: the implementation clears `CachedConfigs` when its four-entry limit is reached, so returning to an earlier color combination can create a different instance. Please qualify the same-instance promise to apply while the entry remains cached. The existing reference comparison remains a useful fast path; this does not request an unbounded cache or claim a separate performance defect.

```suggestion
    /// Returns the host config for content shown in <paramref name="theme"/>.
    /// Calls with the same resolved colors reuse an instance only while it remains cached.
```
proposed_comments.title: Qualify the bounded-cache identity guarantee

confidence.rationale: Exact current source supports this explicitly non-blocking clarification; existing guards and caller behavior are preserved.
